title: Drill 8: Airway Management - Training IDs 6.1-6.5 (Obstruction, Oropharyngeal, Nasopharyngeal, Laryngeal, Ventilation Bag and Mask)
description: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Airway Adjuncts Insertion Procedure To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Ventilation Bag and Mask
objectives: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Airway Adjuncts Insertion Procedure To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Ventilation Bag and Mask

6.1 The participants will be able to discuss signs and symptoms of Airway Obstruction 6.2 The participants will be able to discuss indication and contra-indication for Oropharyngeal Airway Insertion procedure.
Discuss basic relevant anatomy of Airway system involved in Guedel insertion.
Principles of Guedel insertion.
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure.
Discuss risks and complications.
Discuss and demonstrate Guedel insertion techniques. 6.3 The participants will be able to discuss indication and contra-indication for Nasopharyngeal Airway Insertion procedure.
Discuss basic relevant anatomy of Airway system involved in NPA insertion.
Principles of NPA insertion.
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure.
Discuss risks and complications.
Discuss and demonstrate NPA insertion techniques. 6.4 The participants will be able to discuss indication and contra-indication for Laryngeal Mask Airway Insertion procedure.
Discuss basic relevant anatomy of Airway system involved in LMA insertion.
Principles of LMA insertion.
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure.
Discuss risks and complications.
Discuss and demonstrate LMA insertion techniques 6.5 The participants will be able to discuss indication and contra-indication on the use of Ventilation Bag and Mask
Discuss basic relevant anatomy of Airway system involved in Ventilation Bag and Mask
Discuss the equipment, positioning, step-by-step description of procedure.
Discuss risks and complications.
Discuss and demonstrate Ventilation Bag and Mask --------------------------------------
Practical assessment
activities: Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos.
Demonstration on how to apply the above topics.
Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.
